message: Renovate proposes updates after 1 hour (minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" in packageRules[0] of renovate.json), but Cargo waits 3 days (registry.global-min-publish-age: "3 days" in .cargo/config.toml); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Cargo picks itself, and Cargo keeps them, as it keeps the versions in Cargo.lock
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
